citation.authors: Paradies Y, Ben J, Denson N et al

record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of reported racism and health
record.finding: Reported racism was linked to poorer mental health (negative mental health r = -0.23, 95% CI -0.24 to -0.21, 227 studies), including depression, anxiety and psychological stress, and to poorer general (r = -0.13) and physical health (r = -0.09). Effects were stronger in cross-sectional than longitudinal data. Ethnicity moderated some effects; the abstract text I read was cut off before the Black-specific comparison.
record.note: Association, mostly cross-sectional, so it does not prove cause. Abstract read; the sentence on which groups showed stronger effects was truncated in my copy (UNVERIFIED for Black adults specifically).
